subject: Embeddings pricing: vector/unit basis, dimensional tiers & supported models
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novapulse.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novapulse.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Embeddings pricing, vectors vs tokens (Novapulse)

Hi Olga,

We're evaluating Redwood for a product recommendation pipeline and have a few pricing questions to feed into our procurement review. High level: we expect ~8M upserted vectors/month (mix of 1536d and 4096d) and ~30M query vectors/month.

Specifics we need clarified:
- Do you bill embeddings per-vector or per-token for the hosted API? If per-vector, how do you handle different dimensionalities (1536 vs 4096) — flat price or dimensional tiers?
- What models are supported for embeddings on the hosted API today (we'd like to compare quality between text-embedding-3-large, text-embedding-2-medium, and any 2.x variants)?
- Do you offer committed-volume discounts (12-month / 24-month)? If so, please share thresholds and an example rate card.
- Any differences in billing when mixing multiple embedding models in the same project?
- Do you have an SDK call cost or batching recommendation for cheaper per-vector pricing at large scale?

Could you send a baseline rate card (even a redacted one) and a short note on how you recommend we structure a commit for our volume profile? We're on a tight procurement timeline and would like something by end of week if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Product Operations
Novapulse, Inc.

Attachments: Novapulse_Ratecard_Request_080927.pdf
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novapulse.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 13:48:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing, vectors vs tokens (Novapulse)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up-front, followed by an illustrative baseline and next steps.

1) Billing unit: hosted API is billed per-embedding (per-vector) for embeddings endpoints. We do not bill per-token for pure embeddings generation; token-based pricing applies to text-generation and hybrid generation+embedding flows.

2) Dimensionality: we use dimensional tiers. Typical tiers: 768/1536 (small-medium), 3072 (large), 4096+ (x-large). Pricing per vector increases with dimensionality; bulk discounts apply to total vector count, not per-dimension separately (we normalize to vector units for tiering).

3) Supported models (hosted API):
- text-embedding-3-large — 4096d (high quality, best for semantic matching)
- text-embedding-2-large — 3072d (good quality/cost tradeoff)
- text-embedding-2-small — 1536d (cost-efficient)
- legacy: text-embedding-1-series (1536d) — still available by request

4) Mixed-model billing: you can mix models in the same project. Billing aggregates by normalized vector units; if you mix 1536d and 4096d vectors, they map to their respective tiers and count toward overall volume thresholds for discounts.

Illustrative baseline rate card (hosted API, list price):
- 1536d (tier A): $0.00030 per vector
- 3072d (tier B): $0.00055 per vector
- 4096d (tier C): $0.00095 per vector

Committed discounts:
- 12-month, 10M+ vectors/month: 15% off list
- 12-month, 25M+ vectors/month: 22% off list
- 24-month, 25M+ vectors/month: 30% off list + priority onboarding

Batching/storage notes:
- We recommend batching upserts in 256–1024 vector batches for throughput efficiency; this does not change per-vector billing but reduces API calls and latency.
- Export/storage costs for embeddings export (S3/transfer) are separate — see attached ratecard for sample numbers.

Next steps: I'll attach our redwood_embeddings_ratecard_Q3_2027.pdf with the above broken out and a sample PO estimate for your stated volumes. If that looks roughly in-range, Ben (copied) can propose a discount/commit structure and we can schedule a short procurement call Thursday to lock timing.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive — EU Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_embeddings_ratecard_Q3_2027.pdf, novapulse_po_estimate.xlsx
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novapulse.ai>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 10:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing, vectors vs tokens (Novapulse)

Elena / Olga — quick follow. We reviewed Novapulse's volumes and have two practical packaging options that usually fit these profiles. I've put concrete numbers below so procurement can run TCO quickly.

Option A — Committed vector contract (simpler, predictable):
- 12-month term, commit 200M vectors total (avg ~16.7M/mo)
- Effective pricing after 22% commit discount (applies to blended mix):
  - 1536d (tier A): $0.000234 per vector
  - 3072d (tier B): $0.000429 per vector
  - 4096d (tier C): $0.000741 per vector
- Additional overage billed at list price + 10%

Option B — Intro promotional structure (accelerates PoC / first 6 months):
- 6-month introductory period, commit 10M vectors/mo guaranteed
- 1st 6 months: 20% off list for upserts and queries, capped at 50M vectors total across both upserts & queries
- After 6 months revert to Option A or list pricing depending on renewed commitment

Mixing models: blended billing will be computed by model-tier share. If you standardize on text-embedding-3-large for match quality, we can include a further 3% volume discount for multi-year upfronts.

Operational ask: procurement will want line items for estimated monthly spend per tier and an SLA appendix. Marissa, can you drop the SLA appendix and a simple contract addendum (redline allowed) into the drive link Olga attached?

Happy to jump on a 30-min alignment call. Olga — propose Thu 11 Aug 14:00 CEST?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
